name: canonize
description: Turn your web app into a verified knowledge base: /canonize:setup signs you in, /canonize:discover maps it from your codebase (--refine also crawls it with Claude in Chrome), /canonize:scan generates grounded feature guides from your code, /canonize:push sends taxonomy to Canonize for review, and /canonize:setup-ci wires per-test coverage from your CI so passing tests verify the claims

server_url.title: Canonize server URL
server_url.description: Optional — /canonize:setup configures this; set only to override. Your Canonize instance, e.g. https://canonize.example.com (http://localhost:3000 for local dev). Can also come from CANONIZE_URL or .canonize/config.json.

api_token.title: Canonize API token
api_token.description: Optional — /canonize:setup signs you in and stores the token in ~/.canonize/credentials.json; set this only to override with a CI/machine token. Can also come from CANONIZE_API_TOKEN.

repo_slug.title: Default repo slug
repo_slug.description: Optional — /canonize:setup writes the repo slug into the project's .canonize/config.json; set this only to override with a global owner/repo default.
